# AFTERIMAGE exhibit assets

- `belgium.webp`: Formula 1 media, 2026 Belgian Grand Prix editorial image. Source: https://media.formula1.com/image/upload/t_16by9Centre/c_fit,w_1800/q_auto/v1740000001/trackside-images/2026/F1_Grand_Prix_of_Belgium/2286755470.webp. Publication permission confirmed by the project owner for this fan project.
- `monaco.webp`: Formula 1 media, 2026 Monaco Grand Prix editorial image. Source: https://media.formula1.com/image/upload/t_16by9South/c_fit,w_1800/q_auto/v1740000001/trackside-images/2026/F1_Grand_Prix_of_Monaco/2280325141.webp. Publication permission confirmed by the project owner for this fan project.
- `silverstone.webp`: Jason Puddephatt, *George Russell Mercedes F1 Sparks (55383878053)*, Wikimedia Commons, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0). [Source page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:George_Russell_Mercedes_F1_Sparks_(55383878053).jpg). Converted to WebP and sized to 1800 px by the AFTERIMAGE archive.
- `japan-race.webp`: Formula 1 media, Japanese Grand Prix archive image. [Source](https://media.formula1.com/image/upload/t_16by9North/c_fit,w_1800/q_auto/v1740000001/fom-website/2026/Japan/GettyImages-2268873747.webp). Publication permission confirmed by the project owner for this fan project.
- `japan-track.webp`: Formula 1 media, Suzuka track detail. [Source](https://media.formula1.com/image/upload/c_fit,h_704/q_auto/v1740000001/common/f1/2026/track/2026tracksuzukadetailed.webp). Publication permission confirmed by the project owner for this fan project.
- `suzuka-outline.svg`: Suzuka circuit geometry derived from F1DB's pinned source commit `5487e45d4df4097080332f29a0513f275c1023cd`, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). This is a schematic outline, not a surveyed camera position or spectator access map.
- `norris-suzuka-v14.webp`: Martin Lee from London, UK, *McLaren MCL40 - Lando Norris approaches Spoon Curve at Suzuka during the 2026 Japanese GP*, Wikimedia Commons, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). [Original file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mclaren_MCL40_-_Lando_Norris_approaches_Spoon_Curve_at_Suzuka_during_the_2026_Japanese_GP_(55195326398).jpg). Resized and converted to WebP by the AFTERIMAGE archive.
- `piastri-suzuka-v14.webp`: Martin Lee from London, UK, *McLaren MCL40 - Oscar Piastri enters the Nissin Brake Hairpin at Suzuka during the 2026 Japanese GP*, Wikimedia Commons, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). [Original file page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mclaren_MCL40_-_Oscar_Piastri_enters_the_Nissin_Brake_Hairpin_at_Suzuka_during_the_2026_Japanese_GP_(55195174246).jpg). Resized and converted to WebP by the AFTERIMAGE archive.
- `barlow-700.woff2`, `barlow-800.woff2`: Barlow Condensed, SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `LICENSE-barlow.txt`.
- `cormorant-italic.woff2`: Cormorant Garamond, SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `LICENSE-cormorant.txt`.

AFTERIMAGE is an independent, unofficial fan project. This exhibit uses the same photographs and type roles as the published archive.
